customers.evidence: That's our commitment to helping you live your best life.

community.evidence: our purpose is to make the world a better place by bringing life-changing health technologies to the people who need them

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural voice centred on personal wellbeing and life-changing health technology, with the headline ABBOTT IS IN THE BUSINESS OF LIFE. Commitments are stated absolutely, such as our purpose and our commitment, and they address individual customers and society first. Workforce, environmental, financial and governance values are absent. Much of the page is legal disclaimer text.
